tonight.headline: Gordon is still on the bench at 22:05 — and it is the only thing left to fix
body: Bad news first: at the 22:05Z snapshot DK Metcalf is still in the flex and Ollie Gordon II is still on the bench — 2.2 projected points given up, nine hours after the morning brief flagged it. Nothing reported since changes the call: neither is on a Thursday or Wednesday report.

No AVIATO player plays tonight. ESPN projects 128.1 to Guillo-tinas' 88.9, 70%. Stefon Diggs, the morning's worry, practised fully on Thursday (RotoWire 29 Oct) — he stays on the bench by projection either way. Two moves remain: Gordon for Metcalf before Sunday 12:00, and the Coker claim if it is not already in.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Guillo-tinas keep Lamar Jackson (22.4) on the bench. He practised fully Wednesday and Thursday on the ankle and Rapoport expects him to play at Buffalo (CBS 28 Oct, PFT 29 Oct). Set properly they are near 120.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Guillo-tinas fixing their lineup and AVIATO not — roughly 120 to 128. Close enough that the free 2.2 points in the flex matter.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sun 1 Nov 12:00 CDMX — Metcalf's kickoff
doFirst.title: Start Ollie Gordon II in the flex, bench DK Metcalf
doFirst.subtitle: Still not made at 22:05Z. The lineup check's one change: Gordon 14.4, Metcalf 12.2. No unpriced news on either.

case.label: The gap
case.body: lineup_check.py at 22:05Z: as set 128.0, projection lineup 130.2. Gordon 14.4 over Metcalf 12.2 — 2.2 points, labelled PROJECTION, just outside the coin-flip line.

case.label: Gordon
case.body: Miami's lead back since Achane's season-ending ACL: about 18 touches a game since Week 4 and a four-game touchdown streak (FantasyPros 29 Oct); 25 carries, 81% of the backfield in Week 7 (archive). Not on Miami's report; Malik Willis full practice through the groin.

case.label: Metcalf
case.body: Pittsburgh's lead receiver with Pittman (foot) and Roman Wilson (finger) on IR — already in his 12.2. Not on the Steelers' Wednesday report (Steelers.com 28 Oct). No unpriced news on either, so the projection decides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Gordon in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claim clears Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — he misses Week 8 either way
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Carried. Still on Chem waivers at 22:05Z to Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX. If the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Jalen Coker. Wednesday morning's card said drop Fairbairn — a second kicker, on a Houston bye. AVIATO still carry two kickers, and Coker is on Chem waivers until Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off Carolina's report — limited Monday, full Tuesday and Wednesday, no designation (Packers.com / NBC 28 Oct). Plays tonight at Green Bay for nobody. 13 targets in Week 6, 4 in Week 7 (archive).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn cannot start while Bass kicks; Chem starts one kicker and streams it (STRATEGY §5). This is an exception to the churn rule, stated: the rule stops a considered decision being reversed, and nothing in the activity log or Wednesday's brief makes this drop a decision — the plan was the other player.

case.label: The clock
case.body: He misses Week 8 whatever happens — the claim clears after tonight's game. ESPN shows this brief no pending claims, so it cannot tell whether yours is placed. Chem priority resets weekly but AVIATO are 10th: any rival claim beats yours.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive) — then the receiver room did not need him back. If the drop was deliberate and the owner knows something no report says, skip the claim.

doFirst.sources: League file activity 15:13Z · Packers.com 28 Oct · NBC 28 Oct · archive

whatWentWrong.title: The defence add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: 15:13Z: Commanders D/ST in, Jalen Coker out. The card said Fairbairn.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Second day running a drop processed on the wrong player: on Wednesday morning the Bass claim took the Broncos D/ST instead of Fairbairn; that afternoon the D/ST add took Coker. Fairbairn — on bye, a second kicker — survived both.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Coker claim above. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting; the risk is a rival claiming him first.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Coker drop was deliberate — then skip the claim and say why, so the next run stops recommending it.

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup reset put Metcalf in the flex
whatWentWrong.lead: Still in effect at 22:05Z: Metcalf in the flex, Gordon on the bench — 2.2 projected points given up.

case.label: What happened
case.body: With Coker gone, the flex went to Metcalf rather than Gordon. Gap 2.2 by lineup_check.py.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The swap card above. Metcalf locks first (Sun 12:00), so make it before then.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Gordon in Week 8 (archive).

worthALook.name: Makai Lemon
worthALook.lead: A vacancy role: DeVonta Smith and Wicks both DNP Wednesday.

case.label: The player
case.body: 7 of 8 targets, 67 yards and his first touchdown in Week 7 with DeVonta Smith and Wicks out (PhiladelphiaEagles.com 29 Oct). Smith (hamstring) and Wicks (ankle) DNP Wednesday, Smith described as sidelined; RotoWire expects Lemon to lead the passing game again if both sit, while noting Philadelphia rarely feed one receiver. McKee at quarterback caps it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Smith ruled out of Week 8 and Lemon above 20% of targets again — a free-agent look next week. Smith back and Lemon falls under 20%: drop it from the list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Love ruled out of Week 8, Allgeier cleared and named the lead.
